source: Current user conversation, 2026-09-13: the servo side has already been ordered; use the existing Xiaomi MDY-14-ED 120W charger first, preserve a later single-bank conversion, restore the required camera and prepare inexpensive audio. The user never approved the earlier camera/audio deferral. Raspberry Pi/accessories remain borrow-first; printing, fasteners, wire and assembly consumables remain RoboClub-first. The accepted scope remains camera-guided learned beak pickup; existing simulation training is retained, and hardware integration is not physical acceptance. Update 2026-09-18: original servo/controller order fully refunded at merchant; user authorizes preparing two OMX-AI kits and shipping selection, with payment reserved for the user. User reports ROBOTIS US confirmed ten kits by telephone; no independent stock-count verification. Other sourcing decisions remain unchanged. Update after checkout 2026-09-18: user placed order 2034348 for three kits; merchant confirmation read by main task. Two kits allocated to MicroDuck, one retained intact. No physical receipt or tracking verified.

input_fuse.note: One external working fuse, no purchased spare. Supplemental input protection; not a 3.25A current regulator.

power_disconnect.note: One package contains one mating pair. Source side uses recessed female contacts; robot side uses male contacts. Four solder cups need 18AWG wires and heat-shrink. Mark 20V INPUT; never mate to a 5V load.

power_tether.note: Obtain 2.2m each red and black 18AWG copper including termination allowance; use a 2m operating tether. Keep mechanical strain away from the PD board and robot solder pads. Exact club stock remains unverified.

pi_gpio_power.note: Two red and two black 250mm 22AWG leads; terminals must explicitly accept 22AWG. each contact rating >=1.5A. Pi needs a pre-soldered male 40-pin header. Pin 9 remains IMU ground, pin 20 audio signal ground. Keep PWR IN empty and covered; strain-relieve the fixed housing. Do not substitute unrated loose jumpers.

existing_usb_charger.note: User supplied the exact charger label. Reuse it; no charger purchase. The design uses its standard fixed 20V/3.25A PD mode through the original cable, not a generic 120W assumption.

xiaomi_original_cable.note: Locate and verify the exact original Xiaomi cable supplied with the charger. Ordinary USB-A-to-C extensions are not a substitute. No purchase is released; actual availability and 20V negotiation remain commissioning checks.

external_power_fixture.note: Fabricate from club material. Accommodate 29.1x20.3x10.1mm receiver plus fuse insulation and wire bends; provide strain relief at both cable exits. Do not claim an old print is this enclosure.

power_test_instruments.note: Borrow instruments before powered assembly acceptance; current-limited bench supply and a multimeter alone do not measure the required transient waveform. No tool purchase is released.

pi_header_housing.note: Source one low-profile 2x20 female housing and its compatible terminals from RoboClub. Four power contacts must explicitly accept22AWG and each rate>=1.5A; four IMU and four audio contacts must fit the same housing. Preserve correct physical pin locations and check final connector height against gpio-housing-review.json. No kit or stock is assumed.
